versions.content: function ValidateCertificateChain [SWS_CRYPT_50123] Upstream: RS_CRYPTO_02306 virtual ara::core::Result < CertificateValidationResult::Sptrc > ValidateCertificateChain (const ara::core::Span < Certificate ::Sptrc > certificateChain) noexcept=0; Performs certificate path validation according to RFC 5280 and according to the previous configuration of the context. The function ignores any certificates added to the context via Add UntrustedCertificate. Instead, the function validates the provided chain against any trusted certificate that has been set using the function AddTrustedCertificate.
